runs.published_text: Bike stolen from the rack outside Kline Biology Tower between 1 and 3pm today. Cable lock was cut.
Streetlight out on the walkway behind Payne Whitney toward Tower Pkwy, very dark after 6.
Car window smashed on level 2 of the Air Rights Garage this afternoon; glass on the ground, nothing else seen.
Part of College Street near the Shubert Theatre is blocked off. Use Temple Street instead.
Someone was going car to car pulling door handles on Lock St around 10pm, gray hoodie, dark backpack, headed toward Prospect.
Package stolen from the lobby of the Tower Pkwy grad housing sometime this morning.
Big pothole full of water at the corner of York and Elm; a cyclist almost went down.
A man followed two students and yelled at them near the bus shelter on the Green around 7pm; they went into a store and he left.
Security guard posted at the Air Rights garage stairwell tonight, nice to see.
Last night around 11, a man in a red jacket grabbed a woman's purse outside the Shubert and ran toward the Green. She wasn't hurt. Yale PD took a report.
Someone was pulling on car door handles on level 2 of the Air Rights Garage around 11:50 and walked toward York Street. The post time is 9:40 PM, so the reported time may need confirmation.
Two teenagers on bikes grabbed a phone from a student's hand on Chapel Street near the Yale University Art Gallery and rode toward Howe Street.
A car was broken into on Whitney Ave last night. If you witnessed anything, share information with Yale Police at (203) 432-4400.
A white pickup truck has been circling the Science Hill lots for about an hour.
Saw someone get attacked on Crown St about an hour ago.
